candidates.title: Governance-Aware Agent Telemetry for Closed-Loop Enforcement in Multi-Agent AI Systems
candidates.snippet: Enterprise multi-agent AI systems produce thousands of inter-agent interactions per hour, yet existing observability tools capture these dependencies without enforcing anything. candidates.snippet: When an autonomous AI agent does something consequential, what can be proven about what it did?
